svg.text: AI-Boosted 5G-Advanced Core and Charging — Release 19 · architecture
SBI: HTTP/2 + JSON · TLS 1.3 mTLS · OAuth2 from NRF · TS 29.500
APIs generated from 3GPP Forge 5G_APIs, REL-19 (bca84b6) — never hand-written

Solid tiles exist in this repository and are tested; dashed tiles are in scope and not built. Every reference point drawn is a call wired in code (config/*.json), named per TS 23.501 clause 4.2.7. Chip = services served from generated YAML.
every NF: Nnrf register · heartbeat · discover · OAuth2 (ES256 JWT)
BSS — TM FORUM SID / OPEN APIS
inference in-process C++ (ONNX Runtime) · training in a Python sidecar (MLflow)
Every NF registers with the NRF (PUT nf-instances, heartbeat PATCH),
discovers peers (Nnrf_NFDiscovery) and fetches OAuth2 tokens
SCP: Nscp_EventExposure served; indirect routing is not on the
wired path today. SEPP/N32, AKMA and NSSAA are in scope, not built.
N2 · NGAP/SCTP · TS 38.413 — N1 · NAS · TS 24.501 (carried over N2)
in-process quota sizing (kill switch, default OFF)
dedup per data spec · via MFAF
reference point wired in code (TS 23.501 §4.2.7 name · service · TS)
docs/diagrams/architecture.json → render_architecture.py · checked in CI · updated as part of every NF's definition of done
